content: Common to all the models, we initialize our embedding matrix with pre-trained Glove word vectors of 300 dimensions using 6B tokens . Out of 11319 tokens present in the dataset, we found 188 tokens missing from the pre-trained Glove embeddings, so we manually map these tokens to words conveying semantically similar meaning, e.g. we map over ten variations of the word “yes” - misspelled or not picked up by tokenizer - “*yes", “yesa", “yess", “ytes", “yes-", “yes3", “yyes", “yees", etc.
